summary: Release cached Research Library catalogue facts for merged-away forces.
details: The Research Library removes copied static catalogue facts belonging to a merged-away force. Destination prototype facts stay cached, and current research state continues to be read from the force.

The real lifecycle callback and actual catalogue adapter are covered by the existing handler fixture. A bounded 100-merge standalone source run retains under 1 KiB instead of roughly 7 MiB; these figures do not claim native RAM or multiplayer acceptance.

The accepted library presentation, saved personal views, research state and native queue authority are preserved. Current-package save, multiplayer and native performance qualification remain outstanding.
